note: Drop Community Edition 2.670 measurements into the override fields. A null shield override, and a turn letter absent from measuredMaxYawPerTick, keep today's fallback. While a letter is absent, spawn still emits turnModeUnverified and yaw uses fallbackMaxYawPerTick from turn-modes.json. No code change is required to replace a fallback.

shields.sideColumnFactorNote: Multiplies the paired side cells (forwardSide and aftSide) after fan-out. Unverified on CE 2.670. The fallback is the SFC1-lineage ×2. Set sideColumnFactor to a measured non-negative integer to replace it. endFactor does the same for the front and rear cells.
shields.pairingNote: forwardSide is the Shield 2 _ 6 column. aftSide is Shield 3 _ 5. Indexes are shield facings, 0 = front, clockwise. Unverified. Set pairing to an object with those four keys, each a list of facings 0–5 used once, to replace the fallback.

turnYaw.measuredNote: Keys are the letters AA and A–G. A value is max yaw per tick for that letter. A letter with a value uses it and does not emit turnModeUnverified. Letters left out keep the shared fallback.
